---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem
---

## Version and environment

OpenAgents commit/tag, companion repository commit (if used), OS, Python/Node, backend/model (no keys).

## Reproduction

Minimal commands or synthetic input, expected behavior, actual behavior.

## Evidence

Sanitized error and relevant timestamps/session IDs. Do not upload credentials or raw private sessions.

## Checks

Did this reproduce from a clean checkout with locked dependencies? Was a real model/forge involved?
